chapter_title_en: The Final Chapter: An Era of Blood and Hope
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Finale: Millennia of Schemes Yield a Lasting Peace
chapter_meta_description: The Five Heroes of Chaos fall to the ancestors' eons-long design. A new world is born from sacrifice. Xiao Chen and the last heroes guard the peace in a realm where emperors no longer exist.
og_title: The Great End: How the Ancestors Sealed All Emperors
og_description: Pangu, Nüwa, and the Three Sovereigns execute their final gambit, trapping the Chaos Five and all hostile emperors to forge a single peaceful world.
twitter_title: World of Immortality Finale: The Ancestors Win
twitter_description: After eons of war, the ancestors sacrifice themselves to lock all emperors away, leaving behind a world where peace is finally possible.
